left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Age 18-70
  -  BMI: 25-45 kg/m2
  -  Regular internet access
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Currently pregnant, <6 months post-partum, [OR]  nursing, [OR]  or planning to become pregnant within the next 12 months

right.raw_text:
-  Current enrollment in a commercial weight loss program or other weight loss research study
  -  Currently taking weight loss medications
  -  Previously had bariatric surgery
  -  Inability to walk 2 blocks without stopping
  -  Any medical condition for which weight loss, dietary restriction, [OR]  or physical activity is contraindicated
